title: Buddy Tokenizer Engineering and Training Course
audience: Shared foundation available to all 55 canonical divisions where tokenizer/model work is relevant; assignments remain division-specific and require reviewed ownership mapping.
Shared study material available to the 65 MasterBot lanes; Grok-HF-Tokenizers remains the accountable owner lane under the existing crosswalk.

course_references.title: Hugging Face Tokenizers documentation
course_references.rights: documentation study only; review exact license before copying or redistributing any materials

course_references.title: Hugging Face NLP course
course_references.rights: link-only reference; course materials are not automatically cleared for redistribution or model training

course_references.title: freeCodeCamp — Train Your Own LLM
course_references.role: LLM training course including BPE tokenization in the broader training sequence
course_references.rights: link-only reference; no transcript/media download or model-training use without item-level permission

course_references.title: SentencePiece documentation
course_references.rights: review software and documentation licenses separately

objectives: Explain tokenization, normalization, pre-tokenization, subword segmentation, vocabulary construction, and token-to-ID mapping.
Implement and compare byte-level BPE, BPE, WordPiece, and Unigram tokenization on authorized sample corpora.
Measure fertility, compression, unknown-token behavior, byte coverage, sequence length, and multilingual fairness.
Design stable special tokens and chat templates with atomic IDs and strict role validation.
Train a tokenizer only on authorized data with source-level splits and a held-out evaluation corpus.
Pin tokenizer artifacts, configuration, library versions, source hashes, and deterministic training settings.
Integrate the exact tokenizer revision with model training, inference, checkpointing, and model release evidence.
Diagnose tokenizer-induced model regressions without training on evaluation or private holdout data.

lessons.title: Text-to-token pipeline
lessons.outcome: Trace raw text through normalization, pre-tokenization, segmentation, vocabulary lookup and IDs.
lessons.lab: Build a transparent whitespace/character tokenizer and round-trip tests.

lessons.title: Normalization and Unicode
lessons.outcome: Explain Unicode normalization, whitespace, punctuation, combining marks and multilingual edge cases.
lessons.lab: Compare NFC/NFKC and preserve source text offsets.
lessons.assessment: No silent destructive normalization; documented reversible behavior.

lessons.title: Subword algorithms
lessons.outcome: Compare BPE merges, WordPiece scoring and Unigram probabilistic segmentation.
lessons.lab: Train tiny vocabularies on a synthetic authorized corpus.
lessons.assessment: Algorithm comparison includes segmentation examples and complexity notes.

lessons.title: Byte-level coverage
lessons.outcome: Explain byte fallback, UTF-8, unknown tokens and robust coverage.
lessons.lab: Test emoji, mixed scripts, rare symbols, malformed input and code snippets.
lessons.assessment: All valid UTF-8 fixtures encode/decode without loss.

lessons.title: Vocabulary design
lessons.outcome: Choose vocabulary size based on measured trade-offs, not arbitrary maximums.
lessons.lab: Sweep vocabulary sizes and plot token count, model embedding cost and fertility.
lessons.assessment: Recommendation includes cost and coverage evidence.

lessons.title: Corpus quality and rights
lessons.outcome: Apply license, provenance, privacy, deduplication and contamination controls.
lessons.lab: Build an authorized-corpus manifest and source-level train/validation split.
lessons.assessment: Unknown or incompatible rights block tokenizer training.

lessons.title: Train with Hugging Face Tokenizers
lessons.outcome: Use BPE and Unigram trainers with deterministic settings and special tokens.
lessons.lab: Train a small tokenizer locally on original synthetic/first-party sample data.
lessons.assessment: Reproducible vocab and merges/model artifact hashes.

lessons.title: SentencePiece workflow
lessons.outcome: Compare SentencePiece BPE/Unigram and whitespace handling.
lessons.lab: Train and evaluate both models using a pinned library version.
lessons.assessment: Equivalent corpus and comparable metrics recorded.

lessons.title: Special tokens and chat templates
lessons.outcome: Define BOS/EOS/PAD/UNK and role/tool markers without accidental splitting.
lessons.lab: Validate Buddy chat template, atomic IDs, role allowlist and tool-call boundaries.
lessons.assessment: All special tokens atomic; malformed and unknown roles rejected.

lessons.title: Tokenizer/model compatibility
lessons.outcome: Understand embedding matrix size, tokenizer revision pinning and checkpoint coupling.
lessons.lab: Load a pinned model/tokenizer pair and reject mismatched vocab or special-token maps.
lessons.assessment: Mismatch is detected before inference or training.

lessons.title: Evaluation and fairness
lessons.outcome: Measure fertility, compression, sequence expansion, coverage and per-language behavior.
lessons.lab: Evaluate on isolated held-out text across languages, code, names and domain vocabulary.
lessons.assessment: No evaluation text enters training; disaggregated scorecard produced.

lessons.title: Release and operations
lessons.outcome: Package tokenizer artifacts with provenance, hashes, model card and rollback metadata.
lessons.lab: Build a release candidate manifest and verify hashes after copy/restore.
lessons.assessment: Release gate passes only with rights, tests, hashes and reviewed compatibility evidence.

gates.rights: PASS only with explicit source rights and purpose-specific authorization
gates.evaluation: Separate train, validation, test and private holdout by source; never train on holdout
gates.artifact: Pin algorithm, vocab size, normalization, pre-tokenizer, trainer settings, library versions, source hashes and tokenizer revision
gates.model_compatibility: Bind tokenizer revision and special-token map hash to the exact base model and checkpoint
gates.compute: No paid or background GPU execution without explicit compute approval and budget
gates.release: Require independent review, regression tests, private holdout and rollback artifact

mastery.required: All 12 lesson assessments pass, reproducibility evidence exists, and an independent private holdout evaluation passes.
